title: Read-only sed checker refuses GNU sed's read-only -b/--binary option, which master allowed
outcome: claude_sed_tokens_are_read_only accepts the exact options `-b` (also inside a short cluster) and `--binary`. `sed -b -n '1p' f` and `sed --binary -n '1p' f` are accepted on all four read-only paths, while a cluster holding `i` or `f` stays refused, with positive and negative tests.
acceptance: Read-only sed checker refuses GNU sed's read-only -b/--binary option, which master allowed is done
